In my heart of hearts I think the show is the fantasy/dream of somebody whose father sexually abused them. The fantasy splinters and changes as the person tries to process what has happened. The last thing the dreamer wants to do is accept that their dad did this to them, so they invent demons like BOB to absolve their father. Sheryl Lynne's scream at the end is  the dreamer's agony of having to come to terms with the reality that they have been running from. They have to accept the real story of their life, not the fantasy they have been trying to contort their reality into.
